text:
Zara: hi team! Zara here, starting in product design today. tiny blocker: Figma shows `request access` when I click the org invite. also trying to find the canonical product roadmap page and any interview script templates in Notion. who's best to ping for a 10-min setup? thanks! :smile:

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Zara :tada:  Invite sent to zara@redwood.ai. Roadmap: Notion > Product > Roadmap (https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Roadmap). Research scripts: Notion > Product > Research > Templates. If figma invite is stuck try `/resend_invite figma zara@redwood.ai` or reply "manual add" and an admin will assist.

Zara: tried resend, still stuck on the request screen in Brave.

Hector: hey Zara  welcome!! DM'd your figma email and added you to the "Product Design" team. try a hard refresh or open https://www.figma.com/files/recent. I can do a quick 10-min walkthrough at 4pm covering file naming, libraries, and where we keep device screenshots. Do you need mobile device access?

Zara: mobile would be helpful (iphone 12). thanks Hector.

Design Ops Bot: manual add complete  Zara was added to Figma team "Product Design". If you still see "request access" clear cookies or open incognito. Device lab booking: https://calendar.redwood.ai/device-lab.

Zara: can open Figma now, lovely. quick follow-up: are tokens the single source-of-truth in Notion or do we keep them in a repo?

Maeve: tokens are maintained in Notion (Design System > Tokens) and exported to Figma with the Tokens plugin. If anything looks off DM me and i'll republish. Also PMs link feature briefs to Research pages in Notion; each study page has a "scripts" section with consent language and recruit criteria.

Zara: great — last process Q: if i want to run a short guerrilla test next week, is there an approvals step?

Maeve: small guerrilla (<=5 users) just needs an intake note on the Research study template. compensated users or PII require the ethics checklist. i'll DM the intake template and add you to the Research sync invite (Thurs 9am).

Zara: perfect, thanks everyone! i'll join the 4pm walkthrough and the Research sync. closing this thread once invites + Notion links are confirmed :raised_hands:

Product Onboarding Bot: checklist summary: Figma  access confirmed; Notion  Roadmap + Research templates link shared; Device lab  booking link shared; Research sync  invite pending.

Zara: all set, thanks :heart:
